title: KitchenAid KHM926 9-Speed Artisan Hand Mixer $99 (RRP $209) Delivered @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)
body:
Deal: KitchenAid KHM926 9-Speed Artisan Hand Mixer $99 (RRP $209) Delivered @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)

[odysseus] They're all the same price: almond, silver, black..
[PractUser] Does anybody know - is the body metal build or plastic? hard to confirm….
[try2bhelpful] It says plastic with metal blades in material.
[simo1919] this or the stand mixer? what price does the stand mixer go down to?
[spaceflight] this or the stand mixer?
Depends what you're using it for
[try2bhelpful] I have both. The lowest Kitchenaid stand mixer I’ve seen is roughly $500.
It does depend on what you want to do.
I use a stand mixer with ingredients that take a bit of time to whip and the hand mixer when whipping them can be done quickly. The biggest issue is how tired your arm gets holding the hand mixer.
[simo1919] the stand mixer looks prettier, I will not spend this time. my nutribullet hand blender will suffice for now.
[try2bhelpful] If in doubt there are a lot of Youtube videos showing products in action.
[tikei] I use a Braun multimix. So versatile and takes up so little space.
I don't work with dough, just cake batter and whipping cream so hand mixers suffice.
[ozchobie] Yeah they’ve included other colours like silver and pistachio.
On business prime, there is a click to redeem $8 off at checkout but it wouldn’t apply further discount. Went to chat and i got disconnected and chat is no longer available at the moment -_-
[CrikeyCheap] I want to do the same; but something stopping me lol.
[simo1919] lol same, I think I'm addicted to ozbargain, but the thought that one day I'll buy the stand mixer instead, stopped me.
[CrikeyCheap] Yeah, I reckon we’ll hold off and wait for a better deal.
[spaceflight] Note, this unit has a DC motor so the power rating looks lower than its AC competition
Because it's cordless?
According to the photos it is
[lyschid] Never seen it this low, I paid 150$ for mine last year. Anyone needing one should snag this deal.
[Make it so] I wonder how powerful this is. Hard to compare with AC. But a plastic body isn't great. Currently still have the K-Mix one which is powerful and very solid.
[BAHBQ] Replacing our K-Mix with this one and feel the same about the plastic body. SMEG and Dualit both offer metal body mixers, but neither have the DC motor and I suspect won't perform as well as this at low speed.
[Benoffie] Yeah they all seem to be dropping now. The others were $159 earlier
[BAHBQ] All Most colours still available at $99 on Amazon Business (if you have access).
